parts:
How can rgl.snapshot be used in a headless Shiny server? Currently all the images are always black. What I'm doing:
- In the app there is a call to downloadHandler()
- There an html document is rendered using r markdown. 
- The document plots something using RGL
- Then snapshots are taken using rgl.snapshot
- These snapshots are then inserted to the document 

Getting this to work would be really important to me. 

Thanks.
